title: Samsung sees chip shortage extending to 2028, touts long-term supply deals
excerpt: Samsung Electronics on Thursday reported a more than 250-fold jump in chip profit and announced multi-year supply deals with major data centre operators, say...
content_html:
Hyunjoo Jin and Heekyong Yang

Wed, July 29, 2026 at 5:03 PM PDT 4 min read

By Hyunjoo Jin and Heekyong Yang

SEOUL, July 30 (Reuters) - Samsung Electronics on Thursday reported a more than 250-fold jump in chip profit and announced multi-year supply deals with major data centre operators, saying it expects global chip shortages to become more acute and extend into 2028.

The bullish outlook from the world's largest ‌memory chip maker nevertheless failed to ease investor concerns about technology firms' hefty AI infrastructure spending curbing growth.

Samsung stock ended down 0.7% after rising as much as 8.4%, ‌though it fared better on the day than cross-town rival SK Hynix which ended down 5.6%.

"The chip narrative has weakened. Investors are questioning how long their record-high margins will be sustainable," said market analyst Kim Seok-hwan at Mirae ​Asset Securities, after Samsung's chip unit booked a record 70% operating profit margin.

The South Korean conglomerate has signed supply agreements with the five biggest global data centre firms and is nearing deals with five other major players, it said without identifying them.

"Almost all customers are requesting multi-year supply contracts," Jaejune Kim, executive vice president of Samsung's memory business, told analysts on an earnings call.

Samsung aims to secure contracts covering about two-thirds of its memory output over the longer term, Kim said, joining rival efforts to reduce exposure to boom-and-bust cycles.

The deals will last at least five years and typically include ‌upfront payments and floor pricing aimed at hedging the risk of ⁠capital investment, Kim said.

The comments come after a selloff in chip stocks in recent months due to investor concerns about the mounting cost of AI infrastructure and competition from China that could squeeze earnings.

Meta Platforms booked a 91% drop in second-quarter free cash flow on Wednesday, after Alphabet last ⁠week reported its first cash-flow-negative quarter.

A 250-FOLD PROFIT SURGE

Samsung's semiconductor unit posted operating profit of 89.2 trillion won ($61.7 billion) in the second quarter, up more than 250-fold from a year prior. The group's operating profit rose to 89.5 trillion won, in line with its earlier estimate.

Overall revenue rose 130% to 171.5 trillion won.

However, surging chip prices hurt Samsung's mobile division, which reported its first quarter in the red with ​a ​700 billion won loss.

"The chips enriching one side of Samsung are now hurting the other, leaving the group ​more exposed than ever to memory pricing and the durability of hyperscaler ‌demand," said analyst Josh Gilbert at eToro.

content_html_zh:
Hyunjoo Jin and Heekyong Yang

太平洋夏令时间 2026 年 7 月 29 日星期三下午 5:03 阅读 4 分钟

作者：Hyunjoo Jin 和 Heekyong Yang

路透首尔7月30日 - 三星电子周四公布芯片利润增长逾250倍，并宣布与主要数据中心运营商达成多年供应协议，并表示预计全球芯片短缺将变得更加严重，并持续到2028年。

然而，全球最大存储芯片制造商的乐观前景未能缓解投资者对科技公司巨额人工智能基础设施支出抑制增长的担忧。

三星股价在上涨 8.4% 后收盘下跌 0.7%，但当天表现好于同城竞争对手 SK 海力士 (SK Hynix)，后者收盘下跌 5.6%。

“芯片的叙述已经减弱。 在三星芯片部门创下创纪录的 70% 营业利润率后，未来资产证券公司 (Mirae Asset Securities) 的市场分析师 Kim Seok-hwan 表示，投资者质疑其创纪录的高利润率能持续多久。

这家韩国企业集团已与全球五家最大的数据中心公司签署了供应协议，并接近与其他五家主要参与者达成交易，但未透露具体名称。

三星内存业务执行副总裁 Jaejune Kim 在财报电话会议上对分析师表示：“几乎所有客户都要求签订多年供应合同。”

Kim 表示，三星的目标是在长期内获得涵盖其内存产量约三分之二的合同，与竞争对手一起努力减少繁荣与萧条周期的风险。

金说，这些交易将持续至少五年，通常包括预付款和底价，旨在对冲资本投资的风险。

近几个月来，由于投资者担心人工智能基础设施成本不断上升以及来自中国的竞争可能挤压收益，芯片股遭到抛售。

在 Alphabet 上周报告其第一个现金流负季度后，周三 Meta Platforms 的第二季度自由现金流下降了 91%。

利润激增 250 倍

三星半导体部门第二季度营业利润为 89.2 万亿韩元（617 亿美元），比去年同期增长 250 多倍。 该集团的营业利润升至89.5万亿韩元，与之前的预期一致。

总收入增长 130%，达到 171.5 万亿韩元。

然而，芯片价格飙升对三星移动部门造成了损害，该部门第一季度出现亏损，亏损 7000 亿韩元。

eToro 分析师乔什·吉尔伯特 (Josh Gilbert) 表示：“让三星一方面丰富的芯片现在却损害了另一方面，使该集团比以往任何时候都更容易受到内存定价和超大规模需求持久性的影响。”
